originality.rationale: The final infinite-orbit statement is mechanically implied by two inspected prior ingredients. Laface--Ugaglia Theorem 2 proves that the seed class \(L\) is ample on a very general nine-point blow-up and has \(\varepsilon(L;x)=2\sqrt5\) at a very general point. Totaro explicitly recalls that standard Cremona transformations and point permutations realize the affine Weyl action on the marked Picard lattice, that on smooth projective surfaces the resulting pseudo-isomorphisms are isomorphisms, and that very general point configurations are Cremona general. Applying these isomorphisms to any countable sequence of Weyl translates preserves ampleness and Seshadri constants; intersecting the countably many very-general loci yields one common very general surface and one common very general point. The displayed coefficient formula is then the routine Kac-translation calculation. Under the required implication standard, this is a corollary of prior results rather than an original scientific claim.
